Frequent pauses were noted on telemetry
response.rationale: Intracardiac recordings localize the cause to phase IV block within the His-Purkinje system, producing atrioventricular block and pauses. Sick sinus syndrome would implicate the sinus node, not His-Purkinje conduction. Aortic stenosis is present but only moderate and does not explain the conduction block.

rejected.why: Moderate aortic stenosis is an incidental comorbidity and does not account for the His-Purkinje phase IV block or atrioventricular pauses.
Frequent pauses are explained by atrioventricular block within the His-Purkinje system, not by sinus node dysfunction; no evidence directly supports sick sinus syndrome.
